title: 第14章 姐等不了了，今天必须得到你~~
novel_title: 神医小傻驴的乡村女人
content_zh:
周香兰不愧是结过婚的女人，就是奔放，这话说的太有画面感了，李大壮瞬间“火气更深”，一个翻身，跟周香兰调转了方向。

    “香兰姐，你真香……”

    其实，香的何止是周香兰本人，她住的这间屋子都香喷喷的，那枕头边的黑色半镂空文胸，紫色轻纱睡裙，和睡裙下面，若隐若现的黑色小裤……

    就连床上的酒红色床单被套，都散发着阵阵勾人的女人香！

    “傻小子，姐哪里香呀？”周香兰却还嫌不够似的，曲起一条白花花的长腿，贴在李大壮侧腰，水眸如波般看着他，娇吟勾引间，碎花裙的衣领被扯开，露出半片雪白……

    “哪儿都香，尤其是这儿……”

    李大壮再也忍不住，扑向那片雪白柔软……

    天雷马上就要勾动地火，旱地马上就要迎来她渴望的雨水！

    可就在这么关键的时候，李大壮那个破手机的铃声，却忽然响了起来！

    “大壮~别~别接了，姐等不了了……”

    开玩笑，周香兰好不容易盼来了这一刻，咋可能轻易放过李大壮，今天不缠他个腿软腰晃，是不可能让他下这张床！

    可李大壮心中却有点不好的预感，连忙捂住周香兰的嘴，自己一听，果然隐约听见自家院子里传来争吵声。

    “不行，香兰姐我得先回家，下次再说！”李大壮直接从床上跳下来，李香兰想拦，可她浑身软绵绵的，哪里抓得住李大壮？

    “这混小子，弄的老娘不上不下的，他却跑了，真是气死人了！”周香兰身子还软着，露在外面的半片雪白，没了压迫感，别提有多空虚了。

    实在没办法，她只能盖上夏凉被，幻想着李大壮还没走…………

    而此时的李大壮正一边飞奔，一边掏手机。

    果然是秋霜姐打来的。

    “喂姐……”

    “大壮快回来！村长和王耀根，还有好多人，来咱家闹事儿了，让咱爸妈赔他们十万块医药费，不然就拿咱家的宅基地抵！”

    手机那头传来李秋霜带着哭腔的声音。

    随后电话那头又传来王耀根猥琐的声音：“不光要用宅基地抵，你也得给我当媳妇儿！！”
content_en:
The second-rate man running at the front raised a wooden stick and hit Li Dazhuang on the head!

    "Big Zhuang, be careful!"

    The second elder of the Li family and Li Qiu Shuang both shouted nervously, and Li Qiu Shuang held her breath even more, her chest rising and falling, almost bursting her thin summer clothes!

    Li Dazhuang didn't panic at all. He turned sideways to avoid the attack of the second-rate man. He grabbed the wooden stick and yanked hard. The second-rate man lost his center of gravity and fell to the ground. Li Dazhuang raised his foot and stepped on his back, which made him unable to move.

    Another second-rate guy wanted to sneak attack from the side, but Li Dazhuang quickly struck back with a backhand punch. Before the opponent could see what was going on, he felt a click in his eye socket, and his eye bones were actually cracked!

    "Ah!! My eyes! My eyes are blind!!" The second-rate man screamed, covering his eyes that were bleeding and fell to the ground!

    None of the remaining second-rates could withstand Li Dazhuang's fists and kicks. They were either hit in the cheek or kicked with broken ribs. After a while, they all fell to the ground, wailing, and no longer dared to be arrogant!

    The Wang family father and son looked at this scene with shock and fear. It's okay that Li Dazhuang is not stupid, how can he be so good at fighting! ?

    Li Dazhuang walked towards them with a gloomy expression.

    "You, what do you want to do!?" Wang Youcai met Li Dazhuang's fierce eyes, and his legs were shaking with fear. If he hadn't knelt down on the ground and couldn't move because of his son, he would have wanted to run away!

    "What are you doing? Of course it's to destroy your son's life, so that he won't worry about people he shouldn't care about anymore!"

    "No! Don't!!"

    Wang Yaogen was so frightened that he shivered, his nose burst into tears and he said, "Dad, please save me, save me! If this idiot bastard kills me, our family will be wiped out!"

    "Li Dazhuang, I'm warning you not to mess around! I'm the head of Xinghua Village!" Wang Youcai was frightened when he heard that he was going to succumb to the throne. He threatened with a stern expression: "I also have many connections in the town. Captain Zhang from the law enforcement office just drank with me two days ago!"

    "If you dare to destroy my son's life, I will definitely let you go to jail!"

    "Ha, you can try it!" Li Dazhuang said with a sneer, and suddenly made a fierce move and tapped Wang Yaogen twice hard on the lower back!

    Wang Youcai had no time to stop him, and saw his precious son's waist suddenly softening and lying on the ground: "It's broken! Dad! My waist is so broken! I don't have any strength at all! It's over! I'm done! Ooooooh!"

    Wang Yaogen, who still had some of the arrogance he had before, actually started crying without any hope!
title_en: Chapter 15 Da Zhuang, you are too fierce~~~
